"""Read-only saved-scalar publication arithmetic; no new molecular actions."""
from collections import Counter
import csv
import io
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from review_response.hchain_input_reference_preparation import sha_file
from review_response.hchain_odd_extension import (
    BASE, DOC, OUT, STATUS, dimensions, file_entry, git, source_gate,
)
from review_response.hchain_prediction_phase import verify_blob
from review_response.run_hchain_odd_extension import frozen, validate_runtime

root=Path.cwd()
out=root/OUT
read=lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text())
source=source_gate(root)
data,commits={},{}
for name in ('inputs','reference','acquisition','h1','prediction','ground','truth','scored'):
    data[name],commits[name]=frozen(root,out,name)
validate_runtime(out,data['inputs'],allow_ground=True)
new=read(out/'scoring.json')
pred=data['prediction']
identity=data['inputs']['input_identity']
references=data['reference']['references']
phases={p:read(out/f'{p}_execution_audit.json') for p in ('inputs','reference','prediction','truth')}
counts=Counter()
peak=0
for phase,audit in phases.items():
    for name,payload in audit['resources']['systems'].items():
        counts.update(payload['counts'])
        peak=max(peak,payload['peak_RSS_KiB'])
    assert not audit['access']['denied_accesses']
    if phase!='truth':
        assert audit['access']['truth_array_reads']==0
assert counts['reference_pf_actions']==102 and counts['reference_h_exponential_actions']==102
assert counts['candidate_cheap_pf_actions']==6 and counts['candidate_h_exponential_actions']==6
assert counts['m1_pf_vector_actions']==48 and counts['m1_h_matvecs']==48
assert counts['full_H_ground_solves']==2 and counts['direct_truth_coordinates']==6
assert not any(counts[k] for k in ('GPU_queries','GPU_allocations','GPU_kernels'))
points=data['truth']['points']
numerical={
    'maximum_eigenpair_residual':max(p['eigenpair_residual_2_norm'] for p in points),
    'maximum_unitarity_residual':max(p['unitarity_residual_frobenius'] for p in points),
    'minimum_phase_gap_rad':min(p['minimum_selected_phase_gap_radians'] for p in points),
    'minimum_ground_overlap':min(p['ground_state_overlap_probability'] for p in points),
    'minimum_continuation_overlap':min(p['previous_branch_overlap_probability'] for p in points),
    'maximum_ground_residual':max(p['eigenpair_residual_hartree'] for p in data['ground']['systems'].values()),
    'maximum_PF_norm_residual':max(p['maximum_pf_norm_residual'] for a in phases.values() for p in a['resources']['systems'].values()),
    'maximum_H_exp_norm_residual':max(p['maximum_h_exp_norm_residual'] for a in phases.values() for p in a['resources']['systems'].values()),
}
bodywall={p:a['resources']['process_elapsed_before_final_write_seconds'] for p,a in phases.items()}
costs={p:{n:v['timings_seconds'] for n,v in a['resources']['systems'].items()} for p,a in phases.items()}
resource={
    'total_new_counts':dict(counts),'peak_RSS_KiB':peak,
    'peak_scope':'maximum process high-water, not sum of system peaks',
    'process_body_seconds_by_phase':bodywall,'named_stage_seconds_by_phase_system':costs,
    'nested_timings_not_additive':True,'CLI_startup_imports_excluded_from_body':True,
    'H_exponential_internal_matvec_count':'unknown_not_one',
    'combined_H1':pred['schedule_resource'],'combined_H1_includes_Git_freeze_overhead':True,
    'shared_preprocessing':'separate prediction stage timing',
    'classical_units_not_added_to_quantum_proxy':True,'numerical_gate_summary':numerical,
}
even_paths=[
    'artifacts/hchain_truth_scoring_20261004/result/scoring.json',
    'artifacts/hchain_truth_free_prediction_20261004/final/prediction.json',
    'artifacts/hchain_input_reference_preparation_20261004_06922cb/candidate_plan.csv',
]
for name in even_paths:
    verify_blob(root,name,BASE)
even=read(root/even_paths[0])
even_pred=read(root/even_paths[1])
with (root/even_paths[2]).open() as stream:
    even_plan=list(csv.DictReader(stream))
even_refs={n:float(next(r for r in even_plan if r['system']==n)['t_ref']) for n in ('H2','H4','H6')}


def summary(name,scored,prediction,spec,t_ref,reference_status,parity,origin):
    coords=[r for r in scored['coordinate_scores'] if r['system']==name]
    ds=[r for r in scored['decision_scores'] if r['system']==name]
    row=dict(system=name,parity=parity,charge=1 if parity=='odd' else 0,
        multiplicity=3 if parity=='odd' else 1,sector_dim=spec['sector_dimension'],
        CISD_dim=spec['CISD_subspace_dimension'],K=spec['K'],reference_status=reference_status,
        t_ref=t_ref,CISD_H_residual=spec['H_expectation_residual_hartree'],
        coordinate_count=len(coords),origin_result_commit=origin,
        verified_snapshot_commit=commits['scored'] if parity=='odd' else BASE)
    if not ds:
        row.update(q=None,selected_r=None,B0=None,frozen_budget=None,B_over_B0=None,
            budget_reduction_percent=None,safe=None,target_met=None,gamma_min=None,
            fixed_gamma_1_01_safe=None,M1_policy='not_executed_reference_unavailable',
            M1_branch_pass=0,width_cover=0)
        return row
    get=lambda arm: next(r for r in ds if r['arm']==arm)
    b2,b0,h1,m1=get('B2'),get('B0'),get('H1'),get('always_M1')
    cheap=prediction['cheap_B0_B1_B2_q'][name]
    row.update(q=cheap['q'],selected_r=next(p['ratio'] for p in cheap['points'] if p['candidate_id']==b2['candidate_id']),
        B0=b0['frozen_budget'],frozen_budget=b2['frozen_budget'],B_over_B0=b2['B_over_B0'],
        budget_reduction_percent=100*(1-b2['B_over_B0']),safe=b2['safe'],target_met=b2['safe_target_met'],
        gamma_min=scored['system_summaries'][name]['minimum_safe_gamma_in_fixed_frontier'],
        fixed_gamma_1_01_safe=get('B1_gamma_1.01')['safe'],
        H1_identical_to_B2=b2['candidate_id']==h1['candidate_id'] and b2['frozen_budget']==h1['frozen_budget'],
        M1_policy='B0_fallback' if m1['fallback'] else 'selected',
        M1_abstentions=sum(r['M1_policy_abstained'] for r in coords),
        M1_branch_pass=sum(r['branch_correct_shift_gap'] is True for r in coords),
        width_cover=sum(r['empirical_width_covers'] is True for r in coords),
        cheap_errors_Ha=[r['E_C_hartree'] for r in coords],M1_errors_Ha=[r['E_M_hartree'] for r in coords],
        M1_improves_point_error_count=sum(r['E_M_hartree']<r['E_C_hartree'] for r in coords),
        B2_safety_headroom_Ha=b2['error_headroom_hartree'])
    return row


odd_rows=[summary(n,new,pred,identity[n],references[n]['t_ref'],references[n]['status'],'odd',
                  commits['reference'] if not references[n]['qualified'] else commits['scored'])
          for n in ('H3','H5','H7')]
even_rows=[summary(n,even,even_pred,even_pred['input_identity'][n],even_refs[n],
    'saved_identity_verified_reference','even',BASE) for n in ('H2','H4','H6')]
integrated=sorted(even_rows+odd_rows,key=lambda r:int(r['system'][1:]))


def csvtext(rows):
    stream=io.StringIO()
    keys=list(dict.fromkeys(k for row in rows for k in row))
    writer=csv.DictWriter(stream,keys,lineterminator='\n')
    writer.writeheader()
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow({k:json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True) if isinstance(v,(list,dict)) else v for k,v in row.items()})
    return stream.getvalue()


sources=[]
for name in ('src/trotterlib/chemistry_hamiltonian.py','src/trotterlib/config.py',
             'src/trotterlib/Almost_optimal_grouping.py','review_response/gpu_direct_solver_benchmark_instructions.md'):
    verify_blob(root,name,BASE)
    sources.append(dict(**file_entry(root,root/name),origin_result_commit=git(root,'log','-1','--format=%H',BASE,'--',name).decode().strip(),verified_snapshot_commit=BASE))
d,c=dimensions(8,4,4)
matrix_bytes=16*d*d
h8=dict(status='H8_extension_contract_blocked',science_authorized=False,
    system=dict(geometry='centered linear, 1 Angstrom',basis='sto-3g',charge=0,multiplicity=1,
        n_alpha=4,n_beta=4,active_spatial_orbitals=8,sector_dimension=d,CISD_dimension=c,
        sector_kind='fixed_half_populations',group_count=None,current_m3_K=None,
        group_K_status='operational identity not frozen',legacy_same_length_DECOMPO_NUM_candidate=47932,
        legacy_K_is_current_m3_identity=False),
    storage=dict(one_complex128_dense_matrix_bytes=matrix_bytes,one_matrix_GiB=matrix_bytes/1024**3,
        CISD_subspace_complex128_bytes=16*c*c,one_vector_bytes=16*d,
        maximum_dense_matrix_count_under_4GiB_ignoring_everything_else=(4*1024**3)//matrix_bytes,
        loader='retains all dense groups before constructing compact spectra; workspace/total RAM unknown'),
    work=dict(reference_PF_H_exp=[34,34],candidate_cheap_PF_H_exp=[3,3],rank8_M1_PF_H=[24,24],
        ground_solves=1,full_PF_Schur_gap_coordinates=3),
    measured_H7_stage_seconds={p:costs[p]['H7'] for p in phases},
    arithmetic_ratios_vs_H7=dict(dimension=d/735,dense_storage=(d/735)**2,cubic_dense_operations=(d/735)**3,
        interpretation='complexity arithmetic only; not measured scaling or runtime bounds'),
    runtime_estimates={k:'not_evaluable: H8 inputs/group data and operation costs unmeasured'
        for k in ('Hamiltonian','CISD','reference','candidate_cheap','M1','ground','direct_truth')},
    wall_time_range_seconds=None,peak_RAM_GiB=None,
    CPU_feasibility='not established under 4GiB dense-group input loader',
    GPU_necessity='not established; GPU alone does not remove CPU loader issue',
    reuse={k:'exact byte/H/state/PF identity not established in audited Git inventory'
        for k in ('Hamiltonian','grouping','CISD','ground','current_m3_direct')},
    legacy_H8='tracked legacy 4th(new_3) coefficients cannot substitute for operational current_m3 inputs/truth',
    reason='Canonical physical recipe known; operational H/group/state/coordinate/runtime identity not frozen, RAM unresolved. No H8 calculations permitted to close gaps in this preflight.',
    source_registry=sources,new_H8_Hamiltonian_CISD_reference_M1_ground_truth=0)
files={}


def put(name,payload):
    files[name]=json.dumps(payload,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n'


put('system_identity.json',dict(systems=data['inputs']['system_identity'],canonical_audit=read(root/DOC/'source_registry.json')['canonical_audit'],input_freeze_commit=commits['inputs']))
put('input_identity.json',dict(systems=identity,input_freeze_commit=commits['inputs'],runtime_files=data['inputs']['runtime_files']))
put('reference_results.json',dict(systems={n:{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='leading_fit'} for n,r in references.items()},reference_commit=commits['reference'],reference_points_and_all_fit_windows_payload='reference/payload.json',rules_unchanged=True))
files['candidate_plan.csv']=csvtext(data['reference']['plan'])
for alias,directory in [('ACQUISITION_FROZEN','acquisition'),('H1_FROZEN','h1'),('PREDICTION_FROZEN','prediction')]:
    marker=read(out/directory/'FREEZE.json')
    marker.update(stage_origin_commit=commits[directory],stage_payload=directory+'/payload.json',
                  alias_created_at_publication_not_second_freeze=True)
    put(alias+'.json',marker)
files['prediction.sha256']=sha_file(out/'prediction/payload.json')+'  prediction/payload.json\n'
for name in ('ground','truth'):
    manifest=read(out/name/'manifest.json')
    put(name+'_manifest.json',dict(stage_origin_commit=commits[name],source_manifest_path=name+'/manifest.json',
        source_manifest_sha256=sha_file(out/name/'manifest.json'),manifest_self_excluded=True,
        files=[dict(row,path=name+'/'+row['path']) for row in manifest['files']]))
files['system_summary.csv']=csvtext(odd_rows)
files['h2_h7_integrated_summary.csv']=csvtext(integrated)
put('resource_audit.json',resource)
put('access_audit.json',dict(
    phase_audit_files=[dict(**file_entry(out,out/f'{p}_execution_audit.json'),phase=p,
        truth_array_reads=phases[p]['access']['truth_array_reads'],denials=phases[p]['access']['denied_accesses']) for p in phases],
    pre_prediction_truth_reads=0,post_prediction_ground_array_reads=2,historical_odd_truth_artifacts_opened=False,
    original_even_arrays_opened=False,mechanism='Python open audit, named NPZ allowlist, explicit Git byte gates; not OS-hermetic',
    GPU_query_allocation_kernel_CuPy_import=0))
put('execution_audit.json',dict(base_commit=BASE,source_content_commit=source['content_commit'],stage_commits=commits,
    remote_gate=read(root/DOC/'protocol.json')['remote_gate'],
    phases=[dict(phase=p,start_utc=a['start_utc'],finish_utc=a['finish_utc'],status=a['status'],
        audit_path=p+'_execution_audit.json',audit_sha256=sha_file(out/(p+'_execution_audit.json'))) for p,a in phases.items()],
    tests=[read(out/'execution'/n) for n in ('pre_freeze_tests.json','post_prediction_tests.json','post_result_tests.json')],
    full_legacy_test_suite='not_run; focused synthetic/source/immutable-scoring tests only',
    old_even_Git_artifacts_byte_identical=True,original_even_runtime_not_accessed=True,
    new_or_repeat_calibration_after_freeze=0,next_stage_authorized=False,push_authorized=False))
put('integrated_source_registry.json',dict(
    even_sources=[dict(**file_entry(root,root/name),origin_result_commit=git(root,'log','-1','--format=%H',BASE,'--',name).decode().strip(),verified_snapshot_commit=BASE) for name in even_paths],
    odd_stage_commits=commits,even_recomputation=False,even_read_only_after_odd_prediction_commit=commits['prediction']))
result=dict(files=files,h8=h8,odd=odd_rows,integrated=integrated,numerical=numerical,
    counts=dict(counts),peak=peak,bodywall=bodywall,commits=commits,
    prediction_sha256=sha_file(out/'prediction/payload.json'),
    implementation_manifest_sha256=sha_file(root/DOC/'implementation_manifest.json'),
    protocol_sha256=sha_file(root/DOC/'protocol.json'),runtime_files=data['inputs']['runtime_files'])
if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='--file':
    print(json.dumps({'text':files[sys.argv[2]]}))
else:
    result.pop('files')
    result['file_names']=list(files)
    result['file_char_counts']={k:len(v) for k,v in files.items()}
    print(json.dumps(result))
